title: Balancing Quality and Variation: Spam Filtering Distorts Data Label Distributions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical methodology and the impact of spam filtering heuristics on the preservation of label variation in subjective datasets. Although it uses an AI safety dataset (DICES-350) which involves labels for harmful language and diverse perspectives, the work itself is a methodological evaluation of filtering tools rather than a study evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
